curation_note: Sanitized derivative of archived runner attribution outputs. Raw provider payloads, local paths, and private workbench labels are intentionally omitted.

frontier_miss_examples.note: Retained as a hard false-side frontier rather than counted as evidence for LLM success.

interpretation: The selected true-side examples show runner-attributed LLM tool or hint solves that are verified by Lean.
The selected false-side examples show finite-countermodel routes selected by the LLM after mechanical feedback and then verified by Lean.
The main protocol fix tested here was to preserve fresh, untried LLM route choices instead of overriding them with a stale mechanical recommendation.
This is a curated evidence slice, not a broad benchmark or final competition coverage estimate.
